While they would not specify a number or a target for reduction, the management team realizes that it's time -- with the QCSA integration behind them, the groundwork for international expansion laid, and all of the company's corporate resources now located in Texas -- to focus on ways to work on operating costs in the field, and to reduce general and administrative costs at headquarters.
